svg.text: System overview · request path, data model and lifecycles on one page · en-route pooling on fixed routes
Guards: session → role, then ride ownership in the service. Public: /health, /zones, /routes, /auth/signup/*, /auth/login. A lower layer never imports an upper one.
1 account per email · phone · ID · plate
fee only on a cancelled ride (CHECK)
every change: lock vehicle → check → write
database rules hold even if code is wrong
−20% if you shared at least one hop
platform keeps the rest · never < Tk 10
late cancel Tk 20 → the driver who came
PK primary · FK foreign · UQ unique
Cast: Jashim · Bullet (3 seats, UTT → BSH)
DRIVER_ARRIVED = at a stop · STARTED = driving to the next
left at drop-off, cancel or no-show · seat refilled at once

Per passenger: DRIVER_ARRIVED = car at your stop · STARTED = on board · COMPLETED = dropped off (fare locked). Passenger cancels until picked up; driver cancels before the first pickup → riders back to REQUESTED.

Joins (R1–R4): on the route in its direction and at most +2 km / +40% round, car not past the pickup, seats free, pool active. Any other transition → 409; every passenger status change writes a ride_event.

Late cancel or no-show once the car is coming to the stop (after a 2-minute grace): Tk 20, paid with the next ride, earned by that driver. A freed seat goes to a waiting rider at the next match round.
